BusinessErrorCodes.description:
Members:

  • Unknown - Unknown error occurred.
  • ApplicationUnknown - Application is unknown.
  • AuthUnauthorized - Auth not possible. This can happen during all Login and Health-ID Link flows.
  • AuthWrongSignature - Wrong signature provided in a device bound request. This most likely happens if a device is used that has not been added to user account yet.
  • AuthLogoutFailed - Logout failed. This can happen if unknown tokens are provided.
  • AuthGlobalLogoutFailed - Logout failed. This can happen if unknown tokens are provided.
  • AuthRefreshFailed - Token refresh failed. This can happen if refresh token has expired or is invalid.
  • AuthAccessTokenInvalid - The given access token is invalid (e.g. expired).
  • AuthLoginUsernameDisabled - Login with username is disabled.
  • AuthLoginUsernameWithDakDisabled - Login with username and DAK (instead of PW) is disabled.
  • AuthLoginEmailDisabled - Login with email is disabled.
  • AuthLoginIdDisabled - Login with ID is disabled.
  • AuthLoginHinDisabled - Login with HIN is disabled.
  • AuthLoginEmailWithDakDisabled - Login with email and DAK (instead of PW) is disabled.
  • AuthLoginHealthIdDisabled - Login with health-ID is disabled.
  • ChangePasswordLoginRequired - Login required for change password flow.
  • ChangePasswordFailed - Change password failed. This can happen id the old PW does not match (if old PW is required).
  • ChangePasswordDisabled - Change password flow is disabled.
  • DeviceAttestationKeyUnknown - The given DAK is unknown.
  • DeviceBindingUnknownMobileOs - The provide mobile OS is unknown.
  • DeviceBindingInvalidIntegrity - Integrity check failed.
  • DeviceBindingInvalidAttestation - Attestation check failed.
  • DeviceBindingInvalidAssertion - Assertion check failed.
  • DeviceBindingPayloadInvalid - Invalid payload (for device bound request).
  • DeviceBindingRefreshDisabled - Device binding refresh is disabled.
  • EmailUnknown - Provided email is unknown.
  • EmailAlreadyVerified - Provided email is already verified.
  • EmailConfirmationFailed - Email confirmation failed. This usually happens if the given code is wrong or expired.
  • EmailFormatInvalid - Email format is invalid.
  • EmailNotVerified - Email is not verified. (Login not possible).
  • EmailVerificationDisabled - Email verification flow is disabled.
  • Forbidden - Access is forbidden.
  • LinkHealthIdAlreadyLinked - Account already linked to health-id.
  • LinkHealthIdSubAlreadyLinked - Health-ID account already linked. This can happen if user tries to link same Health-ID account to multiple doa accounts.
  • LinkHealthIdNotLinked - Health-ID is not linked. Nothing to unlink.
  • LinkHealthIdUnlinkNotPossible - Health-ID can not unlink (e.g. happens if Health-ID is the main login identifier).
  • PasskeyUnlinkNotPossible - Passkey can not unlink (e.g. happens if Passkey is the main login identifier).
  • RecoveryDisabled - Recovery flow is disabled.
  • RecoveryConfirmationFailed - Recovery code confirmation failed.
  • RegistrationNotPossible - Account registration is not possible (e.g. account could already exist).
  • RegistrationPasswordValidationFailed - Password validation failed during registration. Check PW requirements. (See additional provided error data in ErrorDto->error_data).
  • RegistrationHealthIdFailed - Health-ID registration failed. This usually happens if the given token is invalid, expired or the audience does not match the configured (allowed) audiences.
  • RegistrationUsernameDisabled - Username registration is disabled.
  • RegistrationEmailDisabled - Email registration is disabled.
  • RegistrationHealthIdDisabled - Health-ID registration is disabled.
  • ScopeNotAllowed - Requested scope is not allowed.
  • SessionIntrospectionFailed - Introspection command failed.
  • SessionRevokeTokenFailed - Revocation failed. This can happen for unknown or invalid tokens.
  • UserEnableFailed - Failed to enable user.
  • UserDisableFailed - Failed to disable user.
  • UserDeleteFailed - Failed to delete user.
  • UserReadFailed - Failed to read user.
  • UserUnknown - User is unknown.

publicKey.description:
Base64-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo (DER) of the device's biometric public key. Accepted algorithms:
 - RSA-2048 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256)
 - EC P-256 (ECDSA with SHA-256; signatures must be RFC 3279 DER SEQUENCE { r, s })

requestChallenge.description: Request challenge as received via challenge API.

requestSignature.description:
Base64-encoded signature of UTF-8(RequestChallenge). Algorithm must match the supplied PublicKey:
RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5(SHA-256) for RSA, or ECDSA(SHA-256, RFC 3279 DER) for EC P-256.

Base64-encoded signature of UTF-8(RequestChallenge). Algorithm must match the linked PublicKey:
RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5(SHA-256) for RSA-2048, or ECDSA(SHA-256, RFC 3279 DER) for EC P-256.

signature.description:
Payload signature (Base64 encoded).

iOS: This is the assertion as generated by iOS DCAppAttestService.generateAssertion. Input to generateAssertion is SHA256 of Payload.

Android: This is the signature as generated via Signature.getInstance("SHA256withECDSA").

error_description.description: Description of the error in english.

error_data.description:
Additional error data for some specific errors.
RegistrationPasswordValidationFailed example: 
{"error":"RegistrationPasswordValidationFailed","error_description":"Password does not fulfill the requirements.","error_data":["FailedLength","FailedDigit"]}.
The following sub error codes are possible:
  • FailedBadList
  • FailedDigit
  • FailedLength
  • FailedLowercase
  • FailedUnique
  • FailedUppercase
  • FailedPunctuation
  • FailedRepeat
  • FailedPattern
  • FailedEntropy
